notes: Whole ingredient list is ONE comma-separated line. Split on commas outside parentheses: the parenthetical '(или 9% — 2 ч.л.)' contains its own amount and must not become an ingredient or replace '1 ст.л.'. 'кориандр, чили — по 1/4 ч.л.' is a shared amount ('по') for two names separated by a comma. 'чеснок 2–3 зубчика' range → 2; 'ботва от 4 пучков редиса' has the amount in the middle of the name. Mixed separators in one line (space, ' — '). Fat/acid % stays in the name ('Яблочный уксус 6%'). Line 1 '🥬 РЕЦЕПТ ИЗ МОЛОДОЙ БОТВЫ' is a caps category banner; the dish name is line 2, guillemets kept because the quoted part is the name (acceptable alternative title: 'Рецепт из детства'). Steps are ✔️ bullets; '✔️ заправить:' continues on two plain lines that must be joined. '💡'/'💥'/'📌'/'📩' lines are tips and CTA.
